title: Dspyt-NFTs
tagline: We provide simple interface to interact with NFT.storage. Particularly, the app is configured to store and upload images.
description: We built an interactive web app to upload and view stored images. The app interacts with Filecoin and IPFS. In particular, nft.storage provides an access to storing files and directories that can consist of machine learning models, audio files and images. Further we consider to use this app to make the process of nft minting easier.
how_its_made: This project uses ReactJS to store files/images on IPFS/Filecoin. The storage space used is NFT.storage similar to web3.storage service. The current app can store any file on NFT.storage but is onlly demonstrates uploaded images. Further we consider to use this app to make the process of nft minting easier.
